yaml.title: Funding & Institutional Support
yaml.subtitle: Funding, institutional, scientific, and infrastructural support for the MOVICI research programme

markdown.markdown:
The MOVICI research programme has benefited from financial, institutional, scientific, and infrastructural support from several organisations and research initiatives. ::: {.support-logo-block} ![Université Côte d’Azur — France 2030 Initiative d’Excellence](images/LogoIdex.png){.support-logo} :::
French Government — UCAJEDI Investments in the Future MOVICI has been supported through the UCAJEDI Investments in the Future project, managed by the [French National Research Agency (ANR)](https://anr.fr/en/), reference **ANR-15-IDEX-01**.
Université Côte d’Azur — 2024 Scientific Incentive Credits Additional equipment support was provided by [Université Côte d’Azur](https://univ-cotedazur.eu/) through the **2024 Scientific Incentive Credits — Equipment track** (*Crédits Scientifiques Incitatifs, Volet ÉQUIPEMENTS*).
## Institutional and Scientific Support
MSHS Sud-Est — Maison des Sciences Humaines et Sociales Sud-Est Research support structure for the humanities and social sciences.
CoCoLab — Complexity and Cognition Lab Experimental platform supporting research on human behaviour, cognition, communication, and social interaction.
MSI — Maison de la Modélisation, de la Simulation et des Interactions Université Côte d’Azur structure supporting modelling, simulation, data-intensive research, and interdisciplinary scientific interactions.
DS4H — Digital Systems for Humans Université Côte d’Azur research and graduate-school environment devoted to the scientific, technological, and human dimensions of digital systems.
RISE — Academy of Excellence “Networks, Information and Digital Society” **RISE** refers to the French title *Académie d’Excellence « Réseaux, Information et Société Numérique »*, rendered in English as **Academy of Excellence “Networks, Information and Digital Society.”**
Together, these forms of support contributed to the development, implementation, experimental infrastructure, dissemination, and scientific environment of the MOVICI research programme.
